description: Set a price alert: keep watching a product's price and notify the account owner when it reaches the target. Use this for any 'tell me when this drops', 'notify me at X', 'monitor this price' or 'keep an eye on this' task. Reads the current price in the same call, so one call answers both 'what does it cost now' and 'tell me when it gets cheaper'. The watch keeps running after this conversation ends. Requires an API token.
name: watch_price
